leave_out.text: Leave out the two interview videos (BONUS VIDEO in HELP & OPTIONS, shown after 5 hours of play): about 240 MB smaller (658 MB in the game). Left out, BONUS VIDEO goes straight back to the menu.

texts.game: Your copy of Sonic Adventure 2 for the Xbox 360 (Xbox Live Arcade): its content package, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xex, gd/ and Shader/).
